commands.name: resasm  --help
commands.stdout:
usage: resasm [-h] [--config CONFIG]
              {replay,request,inspect,requirements,assemble,verify,doctor,template,backends,sensitivity,modes,init,inspect-model,init-assembly,check,run,report}
              ...

Model-agnostic residual assembly framework

positional arguments:
  {replay,request,inspect,requirements,assemble,verify,doctor,template,backends,sensitivity,modes,init,inspect-model,init-assembly,check,run,report}
    replay              compiled J2 C3D8 replay with total-history
                        sensitivities
    request             sensitivities from Analysis.inp, Analysis.odb,
                        OTI_UMAT.obj and sensitivity_request.json
    inspect             model inspection summary
    requirements        what a mode needs vs. what is present
    assemble            assemble the global residual
    verify              stress-driven residual + reaction check
    doctor              diagnose readiness; optionally emit config
    template            print a backend's declared contract
    backends            user-readable registry audit (all backends)
    sensitivity         generate sensitivity RHS and solve T U^(1) = -R^(1)
    modes               list assembly modes
    init                start a job: copy a template (--template) or run the
                        interactive wizard
    inspect-model       ASSEMBLY path: what ingredients do I have, what is
                        inferable, what is missing to assemble R?
    init-assembly       ASSEMBLY path: write a resasm.yml recipe from a model
    check               check a resasm.yml is ready to run
    run                 run a sensitivity job from resasm.yml
    report              summarize a completed run's output dir

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG       optional config file (.yml/.json)

commands.name: backends
commands.stdout:
Registered formulation backends
===============================

beam2
  element types : B31, B33, B31_LIKE, BEAM2, FRAME3D
  dof types     : UX, UY, UZ, RX, RY, RZ
  status        : implemented/simple
  available modes: formulation
  material iface : False
  state         : none
  tangent       : analytic
  limitations   : small-strain Euler-Bernoulli initially; 2 nodes, 6 DOF/node; no shear deformation (no Timoshenko)

nonlinear_bar1
  element types : NLBAR2, BAR1, NLB2
  dof types     : U
  status        : verified
  available modes: formulation
  material iface : False
  state         : none
  tangent       : analytic
  limitations   : 2 nodes, cubic axial law; proof backend for OTI FE path

nonlinear_spring1
  element types : SPRING1, NLSPRING1, NLS1
  dof types     : U
  status        : verified
  available modes: formulation
  material iface : False
  state         : none
  tangent       : analytic
  limitations   : 1 node, 1 scalar DOF (grounded cubic spring); proof backend for the sensitivity pathway, not production

shell_placeholder
  element types : S3, S4, S4R, S8R, STRI3, SHELL
  dof types     : UX, UY, UZ, RX, RY, RZ
  status        : contract-only
  available modes: none
  material iface : False
  state         : unknown (not implemented)
  tangent       : none
  limitations   : NOT IMPLEMENTED — placeholder only; recognises shell elements but cannot assemble them yet

solid_c3d8_finite_strain
  element types : C3D8
  dof types     : UX, UY, UZ
  status        : bounded-hyperelastic
  available modes: material-replay
  material iface : True
  state         : stateless total hyperelasticity; F0/F1 explicit
  tangent       : analytic, exact weak linearization for declared measures
  limitations   : C3D8 full integration, real positive-J geometry; isotropic total hyperelastic materials only; no history transport; requires Cauchy stress and Kirchhoff-Jaumann/J tangent

solid_c3d8_small_strain
  element types : C3D8
  dof types     : UX, UY, UZ
  status        : verified
  available modes: material-replay
  material iface : True
  state         : material-defined (stateless for elastic)
  tangent       : analytic
  limitations   : small strain; C3D8 (8-node hex) only; needs a small-strain material (kinematic_input='small_strain')

stress_driven_c3d8
  element types : C3D8
  dof types     : UX, UY, UZ
  status        : verified
  available modes: stress-driven
  material iface : False
  state         : none
  tangent       : none
  limitations   : C3D8 (8-node hex) only; needs exported integration-point stress; no material update; no material tangent (stress-driven)

truss2
  element types : T3D2, T2D2, TRUSS2, BAR2
  dof types     : UX, UY, UZ
  status        : implemented/simple
  available modes: formulation
  material iface : False
  state         : none
  tangent       : analytic
  limitations   : small-strain linear-elastic axial bar (Euler truss); 2 nodes, axial stiffness only, no bending

uel_direct
  element types : U1
  dof types     : UX, UY, UZ
  status        : skeleton
  available modes: direct-residual
  material iface : False
  state         : user-defined (SVARS)
  tangent       : user-provided (AMATRX)
  limitations   : element math lives entirely in the user routine; DOFs/nodes declared by the user element; sign convention (RHS = -R) must be verified per routine

Materials: compressible_neo_hookean, crystal_plasticity, isotropic_elastic, umat
